description: This file contains shell scripts and functions related to managing GitHub pull requests, including URL resolution, push operations via GraphQL, remote setup, branch verification, and push retries. It is part of a build or deployment automation process for GitHub repositories, focusing on automated PR branch handling and push strategies.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url
methods.description: Resolves the push URL for the PR's head repository, using environment variables and fallback to HTTPS URL.

methods.name: graphql_push_to_fork
methods.description: Pushes commits to a forked PR branch via GitHub GraphQL API, handling file content and large files.

methods.name: resolve_head_push_url_https
methods.description: Resolves the HTTPS URL for the PR's head repository, using environment variables.

methods.name: verify_pr_head_branch_matches_expected
methods.description: Verifies that the PR's current head branch matches the expected branch name.

methods.name: setup_prhead_remote
methods.description: Sets up the remote named 'prhead' to point to the PR's head repository URL.

methods.name: resolve_prhead_remote_sha
methods.description: Resolves the remote SHA of the PR's head branch, attempting fallback if necessary.

methods.name: push_prep_head_to_pr_branch
methods.description: Handles pushing the local prep HEAD to the PR branch, with retry and fallback via GraphQL if needed, and verifies push success.
